describes: Two buildings joined by a route that claims to be a real link but cites no source. Routing between buildings can falsely suggest infrastructure, location or data flow.
expected_reason: route r1: a factual route must cite `sourceRef`
fix_options: or set status to 'illustrative' (the line is dashed and a disclosure is drawn in frame)
why_this_matters: Isometric systems look authoritative. The module never invents a network: a link needs a factual source or an honest illustrative label.
limitations: ordinary CSS-skewed cards are not a 3D product model and are not handled here
